breakeven_odds_formula: mindestquote = 1 / win_rate  (decimal odds needed so that, at this win rate, wins on average cover losses; anything below this quote runs at a loss even if the win rate holds)

MoneyBag 2-0/0-2 -> Over 2.5.note: Win rate holds at 72-83% for minutes 55-67, then drops to 46-67% for minutes 68-73. Tightening the upper cutoff trades volume for precision. Observed avg. Over odds (1.91) clear the 1.31x breakeven with comfortable margin.

MoneyBag + 3 Goals -> Over 3.5.note: Win rate is 66-78% for minutes 60-63, then mostly 55-68% for minutes 64-71. Observed avg. Over odds (1.90) clear the 1.43x breakeven.

HT over 0.5.note: Clearly underperforms the other strategies (57.5% vs 70-80%). Sample is small (n=40); needs more data or a rule change before keeping it live. Smallest odds margin of all strategies (+0.20) - least buffer against odds slippage or a small win-rate drop.

breakeven_odds_by_signal_minute.note: Mindestquote per signal-minute bucket, overall across strategies. Shows that late signals need noticeably higher odds to stay break-even.

breakeven_odds_by_strategy_and_signal_mi.note: Mindestquote per strategy x signal-minute bucket (n>=15). avg_over_odds is the observed average Over-odds for that combination. margin = avg_over_odds - breakeven_odds; negative would mean the strategy already runs at a loss in that time window at typically available odds.

tool_calibration.note: Source of truth for tools/moneybag-analyst.html's DEFAULT_CALIB. Recomputed from data/inplayflux_sinyaller_2026-09-20.csv (5000 signals) to replace the tool's previous 30.08.-14.09.2026 window.

radar_x_score.note: No strong monotonic relationship with win rate (71-75% across all buckets from <200 to >=450). Not currently a reliable standalone filter.

market_drop_pct.note: Win rate is fairly flat (69-74%) up to 30% drop, then jumps to 80.3% at >=30% (n=142, small sample - worth monitoring, not yet actionable).
